method: Fresh process for every cold JAX measurement. All execution timers synchronize value and gradient. Persistent caching disabled except in cache experiments. Julia uses one fresh process and two identical solves, with cumulative compilation accounting explicitly enabled. Raw parity samples/gradients remain in workspace measurements; summaries retain residuals. No installations, GPU jobs or agent sessions are requested.

piccolo.timing_note: Iteration times are stdout receipt times; solve_spec includes materialization and output serialization, native wall_seconds times solve! only. Recompile time is a subset of compilation time, not an additional cost.

batch_projection.scope: Serial 3 candidates x 3 seeds; all candidates assumed to have the measured c60 shape and optimization cost. Adds one cold setup/compile/first execution plus the measured warm optimization per job. Excludes runner gate, supervision, checks, benchmarks and independent replays. Not a measured nine-job batch.
batch_projection.comparability: GRAPE and Piccolo solve times are not comparable performance measurements: they use different optimizers, objectives and stopping rules. GRAPE maps tol to SLSQP ftol and minimizes infidelity; Piccolo passes tol to Ipopt with its weighted objective and regularizers. GRAPE's SLSQP reported success on its ftol test after 32 iterations at F=0.999615; Piccolo hit its 100-iteration cap at F=0.999999992 and did not declare convergence.
batch_projection.cache_assumptions: Uses observed cold, repeated-seed and changed-candidate first-call costs, including recompilation when the objective is not serializable. If changed candidates miss: one first candidate, two changed candidates, six repeated seeds; if they hit: one cold plus eight repeated calls. Tracing/setup still occur in each process. Warm Julia is hypothetical process reuse, not a built service.

gradient_validation.reference: SciPy matrix-exponential central differences of the leakage-aware infidelity on the full control model
gradient_validation.reporting_threshold: 1e-7 labels coordinates for reporting only; raw estimates at both steps are retained
gradient_validation.scope: Both channels, all 21 knots, three original bound-feasible amplitude sets and one set with a nonzero first knot outside its fixed-zero bound. Direct loss evaluations only; no optimization.

provenance_note: script_sha256 identifies this summary-only rebuild; timing_measurements and gradient_validation retain the original measurement script digests and timestamps. No solves, objective evaluations or gradient comparisons were repeated during this rebuild.

per_job_pre_iteration_overhead.grape_boundary: Reconstructed startup/import/load/objective/trace/compile/first-execution subtotal before warm SLSQP; excludes warm-up and parity benchmarks, not a measured first-callback timestamp
per_job_pre_iteration_overhead.piccolo_boundary: Observed process launch to first AMICODE_ITER (iteration zero); includes imports, materialization and compilation before that line, excludes compilation occurring in later iterations
per_job_pre_iteration_overhead.scope: Separate setup figures for this fixture, without a cross-solver solve-time ranking. These measured boundaries differ; overhead can change with the problem.
